unreachable_variant.description: same golang.org/x/text@v0.3.7 in the module graph, but main() calls only language.Make

key_finding: Identical dependency (golang.org/x/text@v0.3.7) and identical advisory (GO-2022-1059 / CVE-2022-32149). Naive lockfile matching (--no-call-analysis=go) reports the SAME High vuln for BOTH variants; call-graph reachability (--call-analysis=go, default for Go) keeps it only where ParseAcceptLanguage is actually called (called:true, 1 shown) and filters it to zero where it is not (called:false, 0 shown). --all-vulns re-surfaces the filtered one under an 'Uncalled vulnerabilities' section — demoted, not deleted.
tradeoff_observed: call-analysis=go required the Go toolchain on PATH and a buildable module — osv-scanner runs the build to construct the call graph. --no-call-analysis=go worked from go.mod alone.
